changeSummary: Carry the slot operation attempt identity on the three server-to-vehicle recovery messages. ExceptionRecoverySessionOpened, RecoveryActionAccepted and ExceptionRecoverySessionSnapshot each gain a required, nullable slotOperationAttemptId, so a vehicle that has already settled and cleared its own attempt record can still assemble LoadCompensationRequested, which requires that identity. The server already knows the value and was the authority for it; it simply never told the vehicle. OPERATOR_TIMEOUT joins the error registry for the operator inaction deadline ADR-cross-0058 settles as a determinate failure, which no existing code expresses. CurrentStopWorklistSnapshot gains a required, nullable stationDepartureDeadlineAt so the vehicle can display the server-owned station departure deadline ADR-cross-0055 requires and no existing field could express; it rides the worklist snapshot because publishing a new worklist revision is already the same server step that restarts the wait, and it is nullable because a stop with no continuing load has no deadline.
runtimeRule: Exact ProtocolVersion and exact materialized ProtocolReleaseIdentity required; no negotiation.
optionalFieldPolicy: No optional payload fields exist in this candidate. Future optional fields require proof that omission and ignore preserve safety and business conclusions.
historyPolicy: Published tags, commits, manifests, schemas, vectors and approvals are immutable; defects require a superseding release.
